statement: A gate whose test carries a fixed time limit inside frozen core, and that cannot be given more time, runs first and alone in tools/run-parallel-checks.ts, before the lanes start, so it never shares a machine with the Rust compile or the other gates; today that is check:canonical-payment-surface (15 s, 16 s beside the Rust build in Runtime Checks run 36901597856). It still ends the run red when it fails, and then no other gate starts. All other gates keep running side by side in their lanes. The real runner runs in the test over stub gates that log their starts and ends.
